description: This file contains extension methods for interacting with Roslyn compiler symbols, primarily focusing on syntax and type symbol transformations, attribute retrieval, and type name representations within the Orleans code generation context.

methods.name: HasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a symbol has a specific attribute, optionally considering inheritance.

methods.name: GetAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute data from a symbol, considering inheritance if specified.

methods.name: ToTypeSyntax
methods.description: Converts a type symbol to a Roslyn TypeSyntax, with optional type parameter substitutions.

methods.name: ToDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a type or assembly symbol, with options for including namespace and global specifier.

methods.name: ToTypeSyntaxInner
methods.description: Helper function to recursively build a type syntax string from a type symbol, considering nested types, arrays, and generics.

methods.name: ToOpenTypeSyntax
methods.description: Creates an open generic type syntax for a given type, replacing generic arguments with omitted types.

methods.name: ToNameSyntax
methods.description: Converts a type symbol to a Roslyn NameSyntax object.

methods.name: GetValidIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a valid identifier name string based on a type symbol, including handling of generics and arrays.

methods.name: HasBaseType
methods.description: Checks if a type symbol has a specified base type.

methods.name: HasAnyAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a symbol has any attribute matching a list of attribute types.

methods.name: GetAllMembers
methods.description: Retrieves all members of a given symbol (methods, properties, etc.) matching a name and accessibility.

methods.name: GetDeclaredInstanceMembers
methods.description: Returns all non-static members of a type symbol.

methods.name: GetNamespaceAndNesting
methods.description: Builds a dot-separated string of namespace and nesting type names containing the symbol.

methods.name: GetAllTypeParameters
methods.description: Enumerates all type parameters from the current type and its containing types.

methods.name: GetAllTypeArguments
methods.description: Enumerates all type arguments, including those from containing types.

methods.name: IsAssignableFrom
methods.description: Checks type assignability, based on class inheritance or interface implementation.
